question: What is the task: clustering, classification, regression, frequent-pattern mining, or other?
answer_evidence: Primary: Supervised 6-class ordinal classification (LOS A..F at exact t+30m) & binary severe warning (LOS E/F). Supporting unsupervised: Line-Graph PageRank (92,453 edges), Unified 7D K-Means (k=6 on 3,609 organic TRAIN segs), & FPGrowth (335 rules).

question: What are the features, and which ones are available BEFORE the target/outcome occurs?
answer_evidence: 23D FULL_ML_FEATURES at origin t: 14 LOCAL_ML_FEATURES (<= t, ICT clock & Train Vmax) + 9 GRAPH_CLUSTER_FEATURES (PageRank, in/out degree, neighbor LOS <= t, 7D K-Means cluster_id, Train/past-only priors tau < t). Future-Shuffle yields max_abs_diff = 0.0.

question: What is the split/validation method? Why is it appropriate?
answer_evidence: Chronological 70/15/15 split on 7,885 exact +30m pairs; excluded 3,596 synthetic burst TRAIN pairs -> 1,885 organic TRAIN / 1,167 VAL / 1,182 TEST (purged 50 train + 5 val boundary rows).
